title: Cocktail Menu
text:
Blackberry Raven
    
      The Gypsy searches for the components of a spell that can kill the dead. Making enemies of ravens along the way. 
      Tobias steals a car for Ray. 
      Red  struggles to manage the gang, and intimidates youth gangs to find and return the lost fae booze. 
      For every day they delay, the Gypsy will kill one of their number. 
      The gypsy gets the fae lift working, only it takes him to a midnight realm where he must face a deadly flock 
      of ravens while retrieving moonstones that have never seen the moon. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Car Crash #2
    
      The gang tries to enter the night market, but are denied. 
      Got to go get those fae booze they ditched. 
      Dom has a car crash that puts him into coma. 
      Ray meets the cartoonist of Felix.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Gypsy Queen
    
      Ray identifies Alexi's body. 
      Dom asks the Gypsy for help. 
      The gypsy matron reveals the truth about Anna. 
      Anna goes missing. red identifies she has been banished to the shadow realm!
    
  

  
    
      
    
    The Last Word
    
      Alexi and Dom have a falling out. Dom leave the gang. 
      Alexi is informed by the Gypsy that Zapitovi is a fae. 
      Alexi reveals that Zapitovi was killed 10 years ago. 
      Anna gets her fortune read by the Gypsy. 
      Then Alexi is blown up in a car bomb.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Corpse Reviver
    
      After tracking down the Capitani who kidnapped some Golikov men, 
      The gang massacre the lot and once again kill Zapitovi. 
      Then all the dead are resurrected. 
    
  
  
  
    
      
    
    Dark N Stormy
    
      After tracking down the Capitani who muscled in on Golikov turf, 
      The Gypsy gets the drop and slashes some faces. 
      Ray and Red burn all their cars. 
      The kidnapped Golikov gang member probably died...
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Poet's Dream
    
      The gang head to the dream like, fae night market. 
      Raymond meets Felix the cat. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Spilt Milk
    
      Amalfi wants more pay. He doesn't realise Alexi wants him to join the gang proper. 
      He runs. Someone has been messing with Golikov racketeering. 
      Red and Dom track down the Capitani dogs. 
      We introduce the Gypsy. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    No. 10 Manhattan
    
      The gang board a train to retrieve more fae booze. 
      The Booze is cursed by Zapitovi. 
      The train is hijacked, Dom and Amalfi have to jump from the train. 
      Ray and Red ditch the booze in South side.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Old Fashioned
    
      The gang kill Capitani thugs and Zapitovi and the brothel. 
      Returning with the goods. 
      The cop shake down the hotel and Ray leads them away in a cross city car chase.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Moscow Mule
    
      The gang track down fae booze in a Capitani brothel
    
  


The List of items: Black candles, preferably beeswax <- Got Graveyard soil, taken from an unmarked grave <- go kill a guy and bury him. Then take that soil. Blood of the pure and willing <- Silver coin minted in a year of death <- 1917 year of death. Need 1913 Raven feather <- Got Ashes of a burned love letter <- got Ray’s letter. Tear of a banshee <- Bone of a saint who was never canonised <- someone who has been given the title ‘Blessed’. Or a local saint Water collected from the River that runs through the underworld <- Whisper stolen from a sleeping god <- Name of a person who has never existed <- the Gypsy’s name Moonstone that has never seen moonlight <- obtained a few shadow of a person who is not present <- one of the souls possessing the Gypsy
